  content: |
      # SkyJump3D
      
      A first-person, neon/retro **sky-city platformer-shooter** with co-op. You start on a tower roof high above the
      city and work your way down (or up) through floating platforms, rooftops, arenas and highways — all in a single
      `index.html` built on Three.js. Every model, texture and sound is procedural, so there are no assets to download.
      
      **Play:** https://sky-jump.pages.dev
      
      ## What's in the game
      
      - **Movement:** run, sprint, double-jump (which summons your hoverboard), long glide, wall climbing/jumping, ground pound, rail grinding.
      - **A huge sky-city:** buildings, themed arenas with Guardian bosses, spiral and weaving platform chains, trampolines,
        mega-rails, loops, highways and a Ride Park. Levels get taller and harder each time.
      - **Biomes:** Jungle, Frozen, Inferno, Storm, Horror and Psychedelic zones, each with its own enemies, weather and resources.
      - **Vehicles:** DeLorean-style car and a hover-bike. Hold **Shift** to boost, **E** to get on/off. Drops are cushioned, and
        highways have ramps, kickers and loop-the-loops (cars on wide roads, bikes on narrow trails).
      - **Weapons (1–7):** Blade, Laser, Scatter, Plasma, Railgun, Beam, Arc. Empty weapons auto-switch to one with ammo.
      - **Beyond the sky:** a skyway to the Moon, then the **Alien Void** — ~900 mixed platforms (moving, orbiting, crumbling, thin beams),
        drifting space cities underneath, alien troops and UFOs — leading to Mars.
      - **Warp gates:** hidden until you discover them by landing on their platform.
      - **Co-op:** up to 6 players. On the public site, MULTIPLAYER -> HOST A GAME works out of the box through the online Cloudflare relay (just share the invite link). For LAN / Tailscale, run the small Node relay in `server/`.
      
      ## Controls
      
      | Key | Action |
      |---|---|
      | WASD | move |
      | Shift | sprint |
      | Space | jump · double-jump = hoverboard · hold to glide · wall-jump |
      | C / Ctrl | ground pound |
      | Click / F | fire · Right-click aim |
      | 1–7 / wheel | choose weapon |
      | E | get on/off a vehicle (near one) |
      | Shift (held, on a vehicle) | boost |
      | V / Caps Lock | first / third person |
      | R | respawn at last checkpoint |
      | M / N / G / H | sound / music / gore / hint bar |
      
      ## Run it
      
      **Quickest (single player):** open `index.html` through any static file server, for example
      
      ```
      python -m http.server 8080
      ```
      
      then visit http://localhost:8080.
      
      **With multiplayer + voice lines:** `cd server && npm install`, run `start-server.bat` (needs Node), open http://localhost:8080.
      Put an optional Fish Audio key in `server/.env` (git-ignored) to enable voice lines.
      
      ## Deploy (Cloudflare Pages)
      
      **`git push` does not deploy this project.** The live `sky-jump` Pages project is direct-upload
      (`Git Provider: No`), so pushes only update GitHub. Deploy from the repo root with:
      
      ```
      npm run deploy:pages
      ```
      
      That builds `cf-public/` from `index.html` + `server/voice-lines.json` and uploads it to the
      `sky-jump` Pages project on the `main` branch. To make pushes deploy automatically instead, connect
      the GitHub repo in Cloudflare Dashboard → Workers & Pages → `sky-jump` → Settings → Builds &
      deployments, with build command `npm run cf:prep` and output directory `cf-public`.
      
      ## Project docs
      
      - [OVERVIEW.md](OVERVIEW.md) — architecture, systems, constants and known issues.
      - [TODO.md](TODO.md) — current status and the handoff channel between agents.
      - [PLAN.md](PLAN.md), [PLAN-HOMEBASE.md](PLAN-HOMEBASE.md), [PLAN-INTERIORS-MP.md](PLAN-INTERIORS-MP.md) — multi-agent work plans (vehicles, home base + Guide + missions, tower interiors + 6-player spawns).
      - [PERFORMANCE_AUDIT.md](PERFORMANCE_AUDIT.md) — what to measure and fix for performance.

        "name": "skyjump3d",

        "scripts": {
          "cf:prep": "node -e \"const fs=require('fs');fs.rmSync('cf-public',{recursive:true,force:true});fs.mkdirSync('cf-public');for(const f of ['index.html'])fs.copyFileSync(f,'cf-public/'+f);for(const f of ['og-image.png','oembed.json'])fs.copyFileSync(f,'cf-public/'+f);fs.copyFileSync('server/voice-lines.json','cf-public/voice-lines.json');fs.cpSync('voices','cf-public/voices',{recursive:true});fs.cpSync('music','cf-public/music',{recursive:true,filter:f=>!f.endsWith('_names.txt')})\"",
          "cf:dev": "npm run cf:prep && wrangler dev -c cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc",
          "cf:deploy": "npm run cf:prep && wrangler deploy -c cloudflare/wrangler.jsonc",
          "deploy:pages": "npm run cf:prep && wrangler pages deploy cf-public --project-name sky-jump --branch main"
        },
        "devDependencies": { "wrangler": "^4.151.3" }
      }

      function gamepadTick(nowMs) {
        let gp = null;
        try { const pads = navigator.getGamepads ? navigator.getGamepads() : []; for (const p of pads) if (p && p.connected) { gp = p; break; } } catch (_) {}
        if (!gp) { for (const k of GP_KEYS) keys[k] = kbdKeys[k]; gpSeen = false; for (const k in gpPrev) gpPrev[k] = false; gpLast = nowMs; return; }
        // Left stick -> movement keys (deadzoned); L3 (stick click) = sprint / vehicle boost.
        // The gamepad OWNS these keys each frame: value = physical-keyboard-held (OR) stick-held. Nothing latches.
        const ax = gp.axes || [];
        const lx = gpDead(ax[0] || 0), ly = gpDead(ax[1] || 0);
        const gpWant = {};
        gpWant.KeyW = ly < 0; gpWant.KeyS = ly > 0;
        gpWant.KeyA = lx < 0; gpWant.KeyD = lx > 0;
        gpWant.ShiftLeft = gpBtn(gp, 10);      // L3 (stick click) = sprint / vehicle boost
        gpWant.KeyQ = gpBtn(gp, 4);            // LB held = grapple reel (same as hold-Q)
        gpWant.Space = gpBtn(gp, 0);           // held-A = glide too (held-Space is glide on keyboard)
        for (const k of GP_KEYS) keys[k] = kbdKeys[k] || !!gpWant[k];
        // Right stick -> camera (same clamps as the mouse handler; full tilt ~ 240 deg/s yaw).
        const gdt = Math.min(Math.max((nowMs - gpLast) / 1000, 0), 0.05); gpLast = nowMs;
        const playing = state === 'play' && !paused && !guideDialogOpen;
        if (playing) {
          const rx = gpDead(ax[2] || 0), ry = gpDead(ax[3] || 0);
          if (rx || ry) {
            camYaw -= rx * 4.2 * gdt;

        if (!gpSeen) {
          gpSeen = true;

      // ---------- gamepad (handhelds: Steam Deck / ROG Ally / Legion Go / controllers) ----------
      // Polled every frame. Sticks and buttons are translated into the SAME surfaces the keyboard and
      // mouse handlers use (the `keys` map, camYaw/camPitch, jumpPress/poundPress, atkPress/mouseHeld/aiming
      // and direct interact/weapon/pause calls), so gameplay code needs no per-system changes.
      const kbdKeys = {};                                        // what the PHYSICAL keyboard holds; gamepad ORs with it so real keys never get stomped
      const GP_KEYS = ['KeyW', 'KeyA', 'KeyS', 'KeyD', 'ShiftLeft', 'Space', 'KeyQ'];
      let gpLast = 0, gpSeen = false;
      const gpPrev = {};                                         // previous frame's button state, for edge detection
      function gpDead(v, dz = 0.22) {
        const a = Math.abs(v);
        if (a <= dz) return 0;
        return (v / a) * ((a - dz) / (1 - dz));                  // keep direction, rescale so full tilt = full speed
      }
      function gpBtn(gp, i, th = 0.5) { const b = gp.buttons[i]; return !!b && (b.pressed || b.value > th); }
      function gpEdge(gp, i) {
        const v = gpBtn(gp, i), was = !!gpPrev['b' + i];
        gpPrev['b' + i] = v;
        return v && !was;
      }

        $('msg').innerHTML = title ? `<h1>${title}</h1><p>${body || ''}</p><p><b>${sub || ''}</b></p>` : '';
      }
      function toast(text, ms = 1200) { $('toast').textContent = text; toastT = ms / 1000; }
      function schizoTick(dt) {                                  // hallucinations: phantom toasts, whispers right at your ear, dread jumpscares
        if (!schizoOn || state !== 'play') return;
        schizoAcc -= dt;
        if (schizoAcc <= 0) {
          schizoAcc = 24 + Math.random() * 30;

      function gamepadTick(nowMs) {
        let gp = null;
        try { const pads = navigator.getGamepads ? navigator.getGamepads() : []; for (const p of pads) if (p && p.connected) { gp = p; break; } } catch (_) {}
        if (!gp) { for (const k of GP_KEYS) keys[k] = kbdKeys[k]; gpSeen = false; for (const k in gpPrev) gpPrev[k] = false; gpLast = nowMs; return; }
        // Left stick -> movement keys (deadzoned); L3 (stick click) = sprint / vehicle boost.
        // The gamepad OWNS these keys each frame: value = physical-keyboard-held (OR) stick-held. Nothing latches.
        const ax = gp.axes || [];
        const lx = gpDead(ax[0] || 0), ly = gpDead(ax[1] || 0);
        const gpWant = {};
        gpWant.KeyW = ly < 0; gpWant.KeyS = ly > 0;
        gpWant.KeyA = lx < 0; gpWant.KeyD = lx > 0;
        gpWant.ShiftLeft = gpBtn(gp, 10);      // L3 (stick click) = sprint / vehicle boost
        gpWant.KeyQ = gpBtn(gp, 4);            // LB held = grapple reel (same as hold-Q)
        gpWant.Space = gpBtn(gp, 0);           // held-A = glide too (held-Space is glide on keyboard)
        for (const k of GP_KEYS) keys[k] = kbdKeys[k] || !!gpWant[k];
        // Right stick -> camera (same clamps as the mouse handler; full tilt ~ 240 deg/s yaw).

              if (gpEdge(gp, 2)) menuKey({ code: 'KeyH' });
              if (gpEdge(gp, 3)) menuKey({ code: 'KeyJ' });
            }
            const msUp = (ax[1] || 0) < -0.5, msDown = (ax[1] || 0) > 0.5;   // left stick browse with hysteresis latch
            if (msUp || msDown) {

            } else gpPrev.msDir = 0;

          if (gpEdge(gp, 9)) {                                   // Start button: menus
            if (state === 'title') menuKey({ code: 'Enter' });
            else if (!guideDialogOpen && (!paused || performance.now() - pausedAt > 250)) setPaused(!paused);
          }
          mouseHeld = false; aiming = false; gpPrev.rt = false;  // don't carry a held trigger through a pause

          eUsedProp = false;

        try { window.close(); } catch (_) {}

      function menuKey(e) {
        if (menuMode === 'main') {
          const vis = menuBtns.filter(id => { const b = $(id); return b && b.offsetParent !== null; });   // step only VISIBLE buttons (bExit is hidden)
          let idx = vis.indexOf(menuBtns[menuSel]); if (idx < 0) idx = 0;
          if (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space') { ({ bStart: menuStart, bMulti: menuMulti, bExit: menuExit })[vis[idx] || 'bStart'](); menuRender(); }
          else if (e.code === 'KeyP') menuMulti();
          else if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW' || e.code === 'ArrowLeft' || e.code === 'KeyA') { menuSel = menuBtns.indexOf(vis[(idx + vis.length - 1) % vis.length]); menuRender(); }
          else if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' || e.code === 'KeyS' || e.code === 'ArrowRight' || e.code === 'KeyD') { menuSel = menuBtns.indexOf(vis[(idx + 1) % vis.length]); menuRender(); }
        } else if (menuMode === 'levels') {
          const n = LEVELS.length, step = dir => { let j = levelSel; for (let k = 0; k < n; k++) { j = (j + dir + n) % n; if (LEVELS[j].unlocked) { levelSel = j; break; } } };
          if (e.code === 'ArrowUp' || e.code === 'KeyW') { step(-1); menuLevelsRender(); }
          else if (e.code === 'ArrowDown' || e.code === 'KeyS') { step(1); menuLevelsRender(); }
          else if (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Space') { if (LEVELS[levelSel] && LEVELS[levelSel].unlocked) LEVELS[levelSel].startFn(); }
          else if (e.code === 'Escape') { menuMode = 'main'; menuRender(); }
        } else if (menuMode === 'multi') {
          if (e.code === 'KeyH') menuHostOpen(); else if (e.code === 'KeyJ') menuJoinOpen(); else if (e.code === 'Escape') { menuMode = 'main'; menuRender(); }
        } else if (menuMode === 'host' || menuMode === 'join') {
          if (e.code === 'Enter') menuConnect(); else if (e.code === 'Escape') { menuMode = 'multi'; menuRender(); }
        } else if (e.code === 'Enter' || e.code === 'Escape') { menuMode = 'main'; menuRender(); }

+    if (gpEdge(gp, 0)) menuKey({ code: 'Enter' });
+    if (gpEdge(gp, 1) || gpEdge(gp, 8)) {                  // B / Back = Escape (un-pause during play)
+      if (state === 'play') { if (paused && !guideDialogOpen && performance.now() - pausedAt > 250) setPaused(false); }
+      else menuKey({ code: 'Escape' });
+    }
+    if (state === 'title') {
+      if (gpEdge(gp, 12)) menuKey({ code: 'ArrowUp' });
+      if (gpEdge(gp, 13)) menuKey({ code: 'ArrowDown' });
+      if (menuMode === 'multi') {                          // MULTIPLAYER screen: X = host (H), Y = join (J)
+        if (gpEdge(gp, 2)) menuKey({ code: 'KeyH' });
+        if (gpEdge(gp, 3)) menuKey({ code: 'KeyJ' });
+      }
+      const msUp = (ax[1] || 0) < -0.5, msDown = (ax[1] || 0) > 0.5;   // left stick browse with hysteresis latch
+      if (msUp || msDown) {
+        if (gpPrev.msDir !== (msUp ? -1 : 1)) { gpPrev.msDir = msUp ? -1 : 1; menuKey({ code: msUp ? 'ArrowUp' : 'ArrowDown' }); }
+      } else gpPrev.msDir = 0;
+    }

      function startLevelDef(id) {
        if (levelDef.id !== id) {
          levelDef = LEVEL_DEFS[id] || LEVEL_DEFS.descent; level = 1;
          preloadThen.done = false;           // new world = new materials/shaders: run the compile+warm pass again under the loading screen

          return;
        }
        preloadThen(begin);
      }
      function buildLevelButtons() {
        const list = $('lvlList');
        list.innerHTML = LEVELS.map((lv, i) => `<button id="lvlBtn${i}" ${lv.unlocked ? '' : 'disabled'}>${lv.name}<span class="lvlSub">${lv.subtitle}</span></button>`).join('');
        LEVELS.forEach((lv, i) => { const b = $('lvlBtn' + i); if (b) { if (lv.unlocked) b.onclick = () => lv.startFn(); b.onmouseenter = () => { if (lv.unlocked) { levelSel = i; menuLevelsRender(); } }; } });
      }
      function menuLevelsRender() { LEVELS.forEach((lv, i) => { const b = $('lvlBtn' + i); if (b) b.className = (i === levelSel && lv.unlocked) ? 'sel' : ''; }); }
      function menuRender() {
        $('menuSub').style.display = 'none';
        $('menu').classList.toggle('main', menuMode === 'main'); const hn = document.querySelector('#menu .hint'); if (hn) hn.style.display = menuMode === 'main' ? 'none' : '';
        menuBtns.forEach((id, i) => { $(id).className = i === menuSel ? 'sel' : ''; });
        $('menuMain').style.display = menuMode === 'main' ? 'block' : 'none';
        $('menuLevels').style.display = menuMode === 'levels' ? 'block' : 'none';
        $('menuMulti').style.display = menuMode === 'multi' ? 'block' : 'none';
        $('menuHost').style.display = menuMode === 'host' ? 'block' : 'none';
        $('menuJoin').style.display = menuMode === 'join' ? 'block' : 'none';
        $('menuBye').style.display = menuMode === 'bye' ? 'block' : 'none';
        if (menuMode === 'levels') menuLevelsRender();
      }
      function showMenu(v) { 
        const m = $('menu'); 
        if (!m) { console.error('MENU ELEMENT NOT FOUND'); return; }
        m.style.display = v ? 'flex' : 'none';
        if (v) menuRender(); 
      }
      function menuStart() { LEVELS[0].startFn(); }      // ENTER drops straight into the first level (level select is hidden for now; LEVELS_ALL keeps the rest for when it returns)

      - **Warp gates:** hidden until you discover them by landing on their platform.
      - **Co-op:** up to 6 players. On the public site, MULTIPLAYER -> HOST A GAME works out of the box through the online Cloudflare relay (just share the invite link). For LAN / Tailscale, run the small Node relay in `server/`.
      
      ## Controls
      
      | Key | Action |
      |---|---|
      | WASD | move |
      | Shift | sprint |
      | Space | jump · double-jump = hoverboard · hold to glide · wall-jump |
      | C / Ctrl | ground pound |
      | Click / F | fire · Right-click aim |
      | 1–7 / wheel | choose weapon |
      | E | get on/off a vehicle (near one) |
      | Shift (held, on a vehicle) | boost |
      | V / Caps Lock | first / third person |
      | R | respawn at last checkpoint |
      | M / N / G / H | sound / music / gore / hint bar |
      
      ### Gamepad / handheld (Steam Deck, ROG Ally, Legion Go, controllers)
      
      Works in any browser with a controller connected — no mapping app needed.
      
      | Input | Action |
      |---|---|
      | Left stick | move |
      | Right stick | look (same sensitivity clamps as mouse) |
      | A | jump · double-jump hoverboard · hold to glide · wall-jump |
      | B | ground pound |
      | X | interact / use prop / place block (same as E) |
      | Y | first / third person |
      | RT | fire · LT aim down sights |
      | RB | next weapon · LB grapple (hold to reel; also picks warp destinations) |
      | L3 (stick click) | sprint, or boost on a vehicle |
      | Start | pause (ENTER on the title screen) |
      | `[` / `]` on the keyboard | look-sensitivity down / up (30%–300%) |
      | `I` on the keyboard | invert right-stick Y on/off |
      
      Sensitivity and invert-Y are saved in localStorage, so a handheld remembers its settings between plays.
      
      ## Run it
      
      **Quickest (single player):** open `index.html` through any static file server, for example
      
      ```
      python -m http.server 8080
      ```
      
      then visit http://localhost:8080.
      
      **With multiplayer + voice lines:** `cd server && npm install`, run `start-server.bat` (needs Node), open http://localhost:8080.
      Put an optional Fish Audio key in `server/.env` (git-ignored) to enable voice lines.
      
      ## Deploy (Cloudflare Pages)
      
      **`git push` does not deploy this project.** The live `sky-jump` Pages project is direct-upload
      (`Git Provider: No`), so pushes only update GitHub. Deploy from the repo root with:
      
      ```
      npm run deploy:pages
      ```

- path: todo.md
  content: |
      - 2026-10-26 [BUFFY] GAMEPAD LOOK SENSITIVITY + INVERT-Y (persistence follow-up to the gamepad pass, same session): new `gpSens` / `gpInvertY` next to the gamepad state block, loaded once at boot from localStorage (`towerdrop.gp.sens` as a float, `towerdrop.gp.invertY` as '1') and saved by `gpStoreLook()` at every change (try/catch-guarded; bad/missing values fall back to 1.0 / off). Tuned on the KEYBOARD while playing: `[` = sensitivity down, `]` = up (0.30-3.00 step 0.25, clamp-guarded) and `I` = invert right-stick Y toggle; each change toasts the new value. Applied only to gamepad look (`camYaw -= rx*4.2*gpSens*gdt`; camPitch/fpPitch multiplied by `gpSens * (gpInvertY ? -1 : 1)`, same -0.15..1.3 / +-1.45 clamps) — mouse/keyboard look untouched. The gamepad connect-toast now mentions the tuning keys. Verified by extending `perf/_gp_test.cjs` (self-snapshotting fake-gamepad harness): full-tilt yaw rate scales with the setting (0.84 -> 1.47 rad over the same 600 ms sample after 3 x `]`, stored '1.75'), invert flips the vertical direction (camPitch delta +0.63 -> -0.84 for the same stick-down push, stored '1'), and a RELOAD keeps both (same scaled rate, still inverted) — all of that with 0 page errors. Settings keys live at title too? NO — they are wired inside the in-play keydown section (after the `state === 'title'` early-return), so tune while playing or from the pause menu's game, like the other toggles (M/N/G...). NOTE: `[`/`]`/`I` were unused codes at the time of this change — if a future feature grabs them, move the handlers, don't double-bind.
      - 2026-10-26 [BUFFY] GAMEPAD / HANDHELD SUPPORT (Steam Deck, ROG Ally, Legion Go, controllers; user request "joysticks can't control on a handheld"): the game never read the Gamepad API at all, so handheld sticks did nothing. Added `gamepadTick(now)` polled FIRST in the main `renderer.setAnimationLoop` callback (runs every frame, including paused/title so Start works in menus): left stick -> WASD keys map (0.22 deadzone, rescaled to full at rim); right stick -> camYaw/camPitch/fpPitch at the same clamps as the mouse handler (full tilt ~240 deg/s yaw, ~137 deg/s pitch); A(0) jump edge + held-A = keys.Space (glide), B(1) ground pound edge, X(2) = exact KeyE interact semantics (warp/hintNpc/hintProp/vehicle/placeBlock), Y(3) view toggle, RT(7) fire held (attackPress edge + mouseHeld, releases cleanly), LT(6) aim held, RB(5) weapon cycle edge, LB(4) = keys.KeyQ hold (grapple reel; tap = grappleFire() or warpCycle() when on the warp pad, matching Q's precedence), L3(10) = ShiftLeft (sprint / vehicle boost / ride-summon variant), Start(9) pause toggle (ENTER on the title screen via menuKey). Keyboard coexistence: new `kbdKeys` mirror in the keydown/keyup/blur handlers; every gamepad-owned key is recomputed each frame as `kbdKeys[k] || stick/button` so releasing a stick never clobbers a physically-held key and nothing latches. First connection toasts the mapping summary (once per session; reconnect re-toasts). MENUS are keyboard/touch only except title-Start and pause-Start — level select, host/join forms still need touch/keyboard on a handheld. Verification: inline-script `node --check` PASS; `perf/_smoke.cjs` on the patched file produced 0 runtime errors and the NOS (150 chunks / 14873 m road / VCR 10 hubs) + Rent (223 hubs / 6 arenas / Hell 9 hubs) numbers are identical to HEAD's run; default fingerprint wobble (solids +-1 between boot and rebuild, all other counts + seed stable) reproduces on BOTH HEAD and the patched file across repeated runs, so it is the pre-existing build quirk, not this change. NEW reusable test `perf/_gp_test.cjs` (self-snapshots index.html at run start) installs a FAKE gamepad in-page (navigator.getGamepads override), enters play, and verifies move (5.85 m, KeyW true/false), look (yaw -1.571 -> -2.831), jump (Space held + y rise), fire (mouseHeld true->false on release), sprint (ShiftLeft) — ALL PASS, 0 page errors. NOTE for anyone debugging tests here: my first passes failed because (a) the served page never ran its animation loop until the harness stopped replacing `window.__ng = {` outright (must re-emit `window.__ng = {` after the helper object or every later `window.__ng.x =` assignment crashes the module), and (b) headless rAF DOES run on plain pages but the game page only gets a loop when the module survives to `renderer.setAnimationLoop` — use document.title or DOM state to confirm the loop is alive, not window globals. ALSO NOTE: the working tree concurrently gained an UNSAVED-in-HEAD "THE COMMONS" feature (+~330 lines: commonAreaTick/commonsTick/buildCommons/extra hearts) from a parallel agent session while I worked — it is in the working diff but NOT in HEAD commit 9b2c8b4; whoever commits next should either include it deliberately or coordinate with that session before stashing (I stashed/popped this tree mid-A/B and restored it bit-identical). Not deployable from this repo without the usual `npm run deploy:pages`; not played on real hardware — stick feel (yaw rate 4.2 rad/s, pitch 2.4 rad/s, deadzone 0.22) is a first guess and needs a human thumb.
      - 2026-10-25 [CLAUDE] MARS REWARD + MULTI-PATH MOON/MARS (default level only): (1) The Moon's climb (launch pad -> bounce-pad column -> flat bridge to the Moon) used to be a single zigzag path; it's now 3 parallel lanes (cyan/pink/green beams, one is the original path unchanged) with cross-link platforms every few steps so you can switch lanes mid-climb, same pattern the Mars->planet bridges already used (`LANES=3` + cross-links, untouched). (2) First time ANY player reaches Mars, `spawnMarsReward()` now builds a monument (obelisk + ring of 8 bonus platforms/coins/ammo + a prize weapon pickup) at the shared LAUNCH HUB — the common area every home tower's bridge network funnels into — so there's a visible payoff back near spawn, not just out at Mars itself. Guarded by `marsRewardBuilt` (reset with the rest of Mars state on level rebuild). Dev hooks: `__ng.marsReward()`, `__ng.mars()`, `__ng.planet(i)`. Verified via headless Puppeteer against the live deploy: 0 page/console errors building moon lanes + mars route + planet leg + mars reward in sequence; toast fired correctly. NOT eyeballed in a real browser (headless/swiftshader rendering is unreliable for screenshots) — worth a real look at the moon climb lanes' spacing/difficulty and the monument's exact placement relative to the launch pad roof.
      - 2026-10-25 [CLAUDE] RADAR + CO-OP SPAWN TOGETHER: (1) Radar canvas/display enlarged ~41% (156px->220px, backing 312->440) with all draw constants rescaled; other players' radar dots are now always fixed green (`#4dff6a`) regardless of their random avatar color, so friendlies read at a glance vs red hostiles. (2) Players used to spawn on their OWN home tower — 6 towers on a 600m ring, so co-op friends started ~600m+ apart and often never found each other (root cause of "can't see other players" reports). Fix: host's 'state' reply to a new joiner (sent on their 'join') now also carries `slot: mySlot`; joiner's 'state' handler repositions `pos` next to the HOST's tower (`universeCentre(hostSlot)` + ~14m offset by own slot) instead of their own distant tower. Host behaviour unchanged (stays on own tower). Verified with two real tabs through the full connect flow: joiner landed ~17m from host's tower, both saw each other in-world and on radar immediately. Deployed to sky-jump.pages.dev. Each player's private base/mission/resource state (`mySlot`) is untouched — only the initial world spawn POSITION moved; your own home tower still exists if you walk back to it.

  content: |
      // ---------- THE COMMONS: the shared hub between every home tower and the moon ----------
      // A horizontal grind-ring around the launch pad, four outposts with salvage spurs, two named descent ledges and a purge
      // contract: clear enough hostiles inside the commons and the city grants a permanent extra heart slot for this run.
      // It is built AFTER the universe links so it never walls off a home's approach chain (any ring stone that lands on an
      // existing route is simply skipped, which leaves a natural opening for that route).
      function grantHeartSlot() {
        if (bonusHearts >= MAX_BONUS_HEARTS) { health = MAXHP; return false; }
        bonusHearts++; MAXHP++; health = MAXHP; return true;
      }
      function inCommons(x, y, z) {
        if (!commons) return false;
        return y >= commons.y - 90 && y <= commons.y + 125 && Math.hypot(x - commons.x, z - commons.z) < commons.r;
      }
      function commonsKill(e) {
        if (!commons || commons.done || e.commonsCounted) return;
        if (!inCommons(e.x, e.y, e.z)) return;
        e.commonsCounted = true; commons.kills++;
        if (commons.kills >= commons.quota) completeCommons();
        else if (commons.kills % 5 === 0) toast(`COMMONS PURGE ${commons.kills}/${commons.quota}`, 1200);
      }
      function completeCommons() {
        if (!commons || commons.done) return;
        commons.done = true;
        const got = grantHeartSlot();
        score += 1500;
        if (commons.beacon) { commons.beacon.material.color.setHex(0xffd23a); commons.beacon.material.opacity = 0.5; }
        toast(got ? `THE COMMONS SECURED — +1 HEART SLOT (${MAXHP} TOTAL)` : 'THE COMMONS SECURED — MAX HEART SLOTS', 4200);
        shockRing({ x: commons.x, y: commons.y + 2, z: commons.z }, 70, 0x7dff4a);
        shake = Math.max(shake, 0.6);
        try { sfx.bullseye(6); } catch (_) { try { sfx.kill(); } catch (__) {} }
        const x = commons.x + 6, z = commons.z - 6, y = commons.y;
        heart(x, y + 1.2, z); ammoBox(x + 2.5, y + 0.8, z + 2.5);
        for (let i = 0; i < 8; i++) coin(x + Math.cos(i * 0.785) * 4, y + 1.2, z + Math.sin(i * 0.785) * 4, null);
      }
      function spawnCommonsWave(n) {
        if (!commons) return;
        const pads = commons.outposts.concat(commons.islets, commons.ledges).filter(p => p && p.slab);
        if (!pads.length) return;
        for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
          const p = pads[(Math.random() * pads.length) | 0];
          const a = Math.random() * 6.283, r = Math.random() * Math.max(1, (p.hw || 4) - 2.2);
          if (i % 3 === 2) {                                   // air cover: every third hostile is a watcher eye over the ring
            try { const e = makeDrone(p.x + Math.cos(a) * r, p.y + 6 + Math.random() * 3, p.z + Math.sin(a) * r, 'drone', null); e.commonsGuard = true; continue; } catch (_) {}
          }
          try { const e = spawnBiomeEnemy(p.x + Math.cos(a) * r, p.y, p.z + Math.sin(a) * r, p.slab, null, 0.28, 1); if (e) e.commonsGuard = true; } catch (_) {}
        }
      }
      function commonsTick(dt) {
        if (!commons || state !== 'play' || paused || inInterior || commons.done) return;
        if (net.on && !net.host) return;
        const near = Math.hypot(pos.x - commons.x, pos.z - commons.z) < 170 && Math.abs(pos.y - commons.y) < 95;
        if (!commons.announced && near) {
          commons.announced = true;
          toast(`THE COMMONS: PURGE ${commons.quota} HOSTILES AROUND THE LAUNCH RING FOR +1 HEART SLOT`, 4200);
        }
        commons.spawnCd -= dt;
        if (!near || commons.spawnCd > 0) return;
        commons.spawnCd = 5.5;
        // Count only the guards this ring posted. Counting EVERY enemy inside the commons volume meant the dozens of
        // city hostiles already on the approach platforms satisfied the cap before the first wave, so the garrison never woke.
        let alive = 0; for (const e of enemies) if (!e.dead && e.commonsGuard && inCommons(e.x, e.y, e.z)) alive++;
        const cap = 12 + Math.min(8, (level - 1) * 2);          // the ring gets busier as the run climbs
        if (alive >= cap) return;
        const first = !commons.garrisoned; commons.garrisoned = true;
        spawnCommonsWave(first ? 6 : 3);
        if (first) toast('THE COMMONS GARRISON IS AWAKE', 1600);
      }
      function buildCommons(launch, ux, uz, px, pz, homes) {
        commons = null;
        if (!launch) return;
        const CX = launch.x, CZ = launch.z, CY = launch.top + 0.45, R = 64, N = 40, ringY = CY + 0.35;
        const nodes = [], outposts = [], islets = [], ledges = [];
        const gateA = (homes || []).map(h => Math.atan2(h.z - CZ, h.x - CX));
        const outA = [Math.PI / 4, Math.PI * 3 / 4, Math.PI * 5 / 4, Math.PI * 7 / 4];
        const ad = (a, b) => Math.abs(Math.atan2(Math.sin(a - b), Math.cos(a - b)));
        const nearA = (a, list, w) => list.some(v => ad(a, v) < w);
        for (let i = 0; i < N; i++) {
          const a = i / N * Math.PI * 2;
          const gate = nearA(a, gateA, 0.09), outpost = !gate && nearA(a, outA, 0.10);
          const hw = gate ? 5.0 : outpost ? 5.6 : 3.5;
          const x = CX + Math.cos(a) * R, z = CZ + Math.sin(a) * R, y = ringY + Math.sin(a * 3 + 0.7) * 1.05;
          if (blocked(x, y, z, hw, hw)) continue;                   // an existing route owns this spot: keep the opening
          const slab = addSlab(x, y, z, hw, hw, gate || outpost ? 2.4 : 1.8, null, true); slab.commons = true;
          const n = { x, z, y, a, gate, outpost, hw, slab };
          nodes.push(n); if (outpost) outposts.push(n);
          if (gate) {                                              // six home gates: an arch and a grind line back to the pad
            const gx = Math.cos(a), gz = Math.sin(a), tx = -gz, tz = gx, col = 0x7dff4a;
            for (const sd of [-1, 1]) {
              const post = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.45, 6, 0.45), lam(0x1a2236));
              post.position.set(x + tx * sd * (hw - 0.7), y + 3, z + tz * sd * (hw - 0.7)); scene.add(post);
              const tip = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.55, 0.55, 0.55), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: col }));
              tip.position.set(x + tx * sd * (hw - 0.7), y + 6.1, z + tz * sd * (hw - 0.7)); scene.add(tip);
            }
            const arch = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.4, 0.4, hw * 2), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: col }));
            arch.position.set(x, y + 5.6, z); arch.rotation.y = Math.atan2(tx, tz); scene.add(arch);
            addRail(CX + gx * 10, CZ + gz * 10, CY + 1.35, x, z, col, y + 1.35, false);
            addDashPad(x - gx * 2.2, y, z - gz * 2.2, -gx, -gz);
            const gl = makeLabel('HOME GATE'); gl.position.set(x, y + 8.2, z); gl.scale.set(7, 1.75, 1); scene.add(gl);
          }
        }
        const ord = nodes.slice().sort((p, q) => p.a - q.a);       // the loop: rail across every gap, dash pads on alternating stones
        for (let i = 0; i < ord.length; i++) {
          const A = ord[i], B = ord[(i + 1) % ord.length], gap = Math.hypot(A.x - B.x, A.z - B.z);
          if (gap > 3 && gap < 26) addRail(A.x, A.z, A.y + 1.35, B.x, B.z, i % 2 ? 0x36f6ff : 0x7dff4a, B.y + 1.35, false);
          if (i % 3 === 0) { const dx = B.x - A.x, dz = B.z - A.z, d = Math.hypot(dx, dz) || 1; addDashPad(A.x, A.y, A.z, dx / d, dz / d); }
        }
        for (const o of outposts) {                                // outposts + salvage spurs: caches and a landing for the purge
          const nx = Math.cos(o.a), nz = Math.sin(o.a), tx = -nz, tz = nx;
          heart(o.x + tx * 3.2, o.y + 1.2, o.z + tz * 3.2);
          ammoBox(o.x - tx * 3.2, o.y + 0.8, o.z - tz * 3.2);
          for (let c = 0; c < 4; c++) coin(o.x + Math.cos(c * 1.57 + 0.4) * 4.2, o.y + 1.2, o.z + Math.sin(c * 1.57 + 0.4) * 4.2, null);
          const lb = makeLabel('COMMONS OUTPOST'); lb.position.set(o.x, o.y + 6.2, o.z); lb.scale.set(9, 2.25, 1); scene.add(lb);
          let prev = o;
          for (let k = 1; k <= 3; k++) {
            const rr = R + k * 13, x = CX + nx * rr, z = CZ + nz * rr, yy = o.y - k * 2.4 + Math.sin(k * 1.7) * 0.8;

          const nx = Math.cos(prev.a), nz = Math.sin(prev.a);
          for (let k = 1; k <= 6; k++) {
            const rr = R + k * 15, x = CX + nx * rr, z = CZ + nz * rr, yy = prev.y - 3.6;

              const y = yy;

              const lb = makeLabel(k === 4 ? 'COMMONS · LEDGE 0' : 'COMMONS · LEDGE -1');
              lb.position.set(x, y + 7, z); lb.scale.set(11, 2.75, 1); scene.add(lb);
              ledges.push({ x, z, y, hw, slab: sl });
              if (k === 6) {                                      // gold beacon + launch back to the ring
                beacon(x, y + 1, z, 0xffd23a);
                const bx = x + nx * 3.5, bz = z + nz * 3.5;
                const bp = addSolid(bx - 2.5, bx + 2.5, y, y + 0.4, bz - 2.5, bz + 2.5); bp.bounce = true; bp.boost = Math.sqrt(2 * GRAV * 34);
                const bm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(5, 0.4, 5), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff3fc8 }));
                bm.position.set(bx, y + 0.2, bz); scene.add(bm);
                const beam = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.5, 0.5, 34, 8), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff3fc8, transparent: true, opacity: 0.18, blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending, depthWrite: false }));
                beam.position.set(bx, y + 17, bz); scene.add(beam);
              }

> _Reasoning_
> Now I understand the commons geometry: ring at CY (launch top + ~0.45), ledges descend steps of 3.6 down to LEDGE -1 at k=6 (~21.6 below ring). radius extends out ~R+6*15=154. The "mid range before -1 but below spawn area" — the user is referring to these LEDGE 0 / LEDGE -1 labels! The ledges are named "LEDGE 0" and "LEDGE -1" — so "before -1 but below the spawn area" = depths ABOVE ledge -1, i.e., between the ring and LEDGE -1 — the mid band of the commons. So they want new locations hanging BELOW the ring and in the band above ledge -1 — i.e., alongside/before LEDGE -1 ("so before -1 but below the spawn area" = below spawn ring but above ledge -1). Mid-range depth.

        const c = zone ? zone.plate : 0x36f6ff; let mat = kneeMats.get(c); if (!mat) { mat = lam(c, { emissive: c, emissiveIntensity: 0.55 }); kneeMats.set(c, mat); }

      function netSnapshot(all) {
        const spots = [pos, ...[...net.peers.values()].filter(p => p.seen).map(p => p.tgt)];
        const out = [];
        enemies.forEach((e, i) => {
          if (e.dead) { if (all) out.push([i, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 1, 0, 0]); return; }
          if (!all && !spots.some(s => Math.hypot(s.x - e.x, s.z - e.z) < (e.boss ? 180 : 120) && Math.abs(s.y - e.y) < 80)) return;
          out.push([i, +e.x.toFixed(2), +(e.kind === 'drone' ? e.cy : e.y).toFixed(2), +e.z.toFixed(2), +e.mesh.rotation.y.toFixed(2), e.hp, 0, e.hit > 0 ? 1 : 0, e.slamT > 0 ? 1 : 0]);
        });
        return out;
      }
      function remoteKill(e) {
        const mine = e.netMineAt && performance.now() - e.netMineAt < 15000;   // only the player who actually hit it gets mission credit
        e.dead = true; if (mine) missionEnemyKilled(e); e.mesh.removeFromParent(); if (e.warn) e.warn.visible = false;
        sfx.kill(); enemyDeathVoice(e); enemyGore(e); score += e.pts; dropAmmo(e); shake = Math.max(shake, e.boss ? 1.2 : 0.3); killFx(e, e.boss);
        if (e.mini) unlockArena(e.hub);
        if (e.boss && endBosses.every(b => b.dead) && groundPad && groundPad.seal) { groundPad.seal.material.color.setHex(0x5aff8a); groundPad.seal.material.opacity = 0.4; }
      }
      function netApplySnap(list) {
        if (!Array.isArray(list)) return;
        for (const a of list) {
          const e = enemies[a[0] | 0]; if (!e) continue;
          if (a[6]) { if (!e.dead) remoteKill(e); continue; }
          if (e.dead) continue;
          e.tx = num(a[1]); e.ty = num(a[2]); e.tz = num(a[3]); e.try = num(a[4]);
          e.hp = num(a[5]); if (a[7]) e.hit = Math.max(e.hit, 0.1);
          if (e.boss && e.warn) { e.warn.visible = !!a[8]; e.warn.position.set(e.x, 0.1, e.z); e.warn.material.opacity = 0.25 + 0.25 * Math.abs(Math.sin(performance.now() / 70)); }
        }
      }
      function clientEnemy(e, dt) {               // glide toward the host's latest snapshot
        if (e.tx === undefined) return;
        const k = 1 - Math.exp(-dt * 12);
        e.x += (e.tx - e.x) * k; e.z += (e.tz - e.z) * k;
        if (e.kind === 'drone') { e.cy += (e.ty - e.cy) * k; e.y = e.cy - 0.55; e.mesh.position.set(e.x, e.cy, e.z); e.ring.rotation.z += dt * 8; }
        else { e.y = e.ty; e.mesh.position.set(e.x, e.y, e.z); }
        let d = e.try - e.mesh.rotation.y; d = Math.atan2(Math.sin(d), Math.cos(d)); e.mesh.rotation.y += d * Math.min(1, dt * 12);
      }
      
      function netPeerUpdate(id, m) {
        let p = net.peers.get(id);
        if (!p) { addPeer(id); p = net.peers.get(id); if (!p) return; }
        p.tgt.set(num(m.x), num(m.y), num(m.z)); p.tface = num(m.f); p.w = clamp(m.w | 0, 0, WEAPONS.length - 1); p.s = m.s | 0; p.hp = clamp(m.h | 0, 0, 9);
        if ((m.a | 0) !== p.a) { p.a = m.a | 0; p.swing = 0.28; }
        if (!p.seen) { p.pos.copy(p.tgt); p.seen = true; }
        p.alive = !(p.s & 8);

      function makeDrone(hx, hy, hz, variant = 'drone', biome = null) {   // an EYE — a big glowing eyeball that stares at you from the air
        // 'bomber' = bloodshot berserk eye that kamikaze-explodes; regular 'drone' = calm pale-blue watcher
        const bomber = variant === 'bomber';
        const sperm = new THREE.Group();        // the eyeball ("sperm" = eye stalk cluster shape)
        const mat = retroMaterial(new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: bomber ? 0xa8b4c4 : 0xb0b8c8 }));   // sclera
        const shell = retroMaterial(new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: bomber ? 0x7a0e0e : 0x48526c }));  // optic ring
        const steel = retroMaterial(new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x5a6578 }));
        // eyeball sphere: chunky PS1 sphere, iris + pupil front, glow rim from the existing neon kit
        sperm.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.55, 8, 5), mat));
        const biomeEye = ({ Jungle: 0xb5f35a, Psychedelic: 0xf14bff, Frozen: 0x9cf4ff, Inferno: 0xff672e, Storm: 0x74aaff, Horror: 0xff173c })[biome && biome.name] || 0x22aaff;
        const irisCol = bomber ? 0xff3a5a : biomeEye;                       // each biome retunes the optic
        const iris = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.36, 8, 5), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: irisCol }));
        iris.position.z = 0.36; sperm.add(iris);
        const pupil = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.16, 6, 4), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x05060c }));
        pupil.position.z = 0.58; sperm.add(pupil);            // black pupil staring dead center, like a real eyeball
        // glowing optic-ring band (replaces the old hull band) — cyan for drone, magenta for bomber
        const bandCol = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: bomber ? 0xff3fc8 : biomeEye });
        const bandRing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.56, 0.055, 4, 10), bandCol);
        bandRing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; bandRing.position.y = 0.0; sperm.add(bandRing);
        // iris runs in tiny veins when we're in 'bomber' mode — bloodshot / berserk eye
        if (bomber) {
          for (let k = 0; k < 5; k++) {
            const vein = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.06, 0.05, 0.05), new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff2a4a }));
            const a = (k / 5) * Math.PI * 2, r = 0.22 + (k % 2) * 0.09;
            vein.position.set(Math.cos(a) * r, Math.sin(a) * r, 0.62); sperm.add(vein);
          }
        }
        // e.ring stays the spin target the game loop already drives; hang the rotors off it
        const ring = new THREE.Group();
        // rotor Housing — thin torus arc around the eyeball like an optic halo, plus 3 spinning blades
        const ringTorus = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.85, 0.07, 4, 10), shell);
        ringTorus.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; ring.add(ringTorus);
        const rotorHub = new THREE.Group();
        rotorHub.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2;
        for (let k = 0; k < 3; k++) {
          const blade = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.7, 0.03, 0.1), steel);
          blade.rotation.y = (k / 3) * Math.PI; rotorHub.add(blade);
        }
        ring.add(rotorHub);
        sperm.add(ring);
        // 4 rotor arm stubs that hang the ring/band off the eyeball like eyelashes
        for (let k = 0; k < 4; k++) {
          const arm = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(0.14, 0.08, 0.5), steel);
          arm.position.set(k < 2 ? -0.6 : 0.6, 0.05, k % 2 === 0 ? -0.6 : 0.6);
          arm.rotation.y = Math.atan2(arm.position.x, arm.position.z) - Math.PI / 2;
          sperm.add(arm);
          const housing = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.TorusGeometry(0.24, 0.05, 4, 8), steel);
          housing.position.set(arm.position.x, arm.position.y + 0.06, arm.position.z);
          housing.rotation.x = Math.PI / 2; sperm.add(housing);
        }
        // optic nerve planting forward at the bottom so the silhouette reads from below
        const nerve = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.06, 0.06, 0.24, 5), steel);
        nerve.position.y = -0.58; sperm.add(nerve);
        sperm.position.set(hx, hy, hz); scene.add(sperm);
        const e = { kind: 'drone', mesh: sperm, ring, mat, zone: biome || null, x: hx, cy: hy, y: hy - 0.55, z: hz, hx, hy, hz, ph: rand() * 6, w: 0.5 + rand() * 0.3,
          hp: 1, maxhp: 1, r: 0.65, h: 1.1, kx: 0, kz: 0, ky: 0, stun: 0, hit: 0, dead: false, pts: bomber ? 60 : 40, variant };
        e.mesh.add(new THREE.Mesh(aggroGeo, aggroMat)).position.y = e.h + 1.1;    // floating red arrow over the eyeball

      function spawnBiomeEnemy(x, y, z, plat, zone, depth, scale = 1) {
        // Keep every home tower column and its first approach calm at every level, including secondary route spawns.
        if (activeStartHubs().some(home => Math.hypot(x - home.x, z - home.z) < 50)) return null;
        const variant = pickEnemy(depth, zone);
        if (variant === 'roach' && !spawnBiomeEnemy.swarm) { spawnBiomeEnemy.swarm = true; for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) spawnBiomeEnemy(x + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3, y, z + (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3, plat, zone, depth, scale * 0.8); spawnBiomeEnemy.swarm = false; }
        if (variant === 'drone' || variant === 'bomber') { const e = makeDrone(x, y + 3, z, variant, zone); e.zone = zone || null; return e; }
        if (variant === 'ufo') { const e = makeUfo(x, y + 7, z); e.zone = zone || null; return e; }
        const e = makeWalker(x, y, z, plat, scale, false, variant); e.zone = zone || null; return e;
      }
      
      // ---------- biome evolution: enemies mutate into the current biome's species ----------
      let lastEvolveZone = null, evolveT = 20;
      const evolveCap = () => 70 + level * 12;
      function spawnEvolutionPack(zone) {
        if (!zone || state !== 'play') return;                                    // only during live play
        const roster = BIOME_ENEMIES[zone.name]; if (!roster) return;             // Ride Park / Moon crowds stay wild
        if (net.on && !net.host) return;                                          // host ghosts the drip into guests
        if (enemies.filter(e => !e.dead).length > evolveCap()) return;            // respect the perf budget
        const around = 3 + ((Math.random() * 3) | 0);;
        const base = standOn;
        const total = 2 + ((Math.random() * (zone.name === 'Jungle' ? 4 : 3)) | 0);   // jungle = big animal packs
        for (let i = 0; i < total; i++) {
          const variant = roster[(Math.random() * roster.length) | 0];
          const a = (i / total) * Math.PI * 2 + Math.random(), r = 5 + Math.random() * 8;
          let x = pos.x + Math.cos(a) * r, z = pos.z + Math.sin(a) * r, plat = null;
          if (base && base.minx !== undefined) {
            plat = base;
            x = clamp(x, base.minx + 1.2, base.maxx - 1.2);
            z = clamp(z, base.minz + 1.2, base.maxz - 1.2);
          }
          spawnBiomeEnemy(x, pos.y, z, plat, zone, 0.75);
        }
        const evolved = zone.name === 'Jungle' ? 'dinosaurs' : zone.name === 'Frozen' ? 'cryo raptors' : zone.name === 'Inferno' ? 'furnace fiends'
          : zone.name === 'Storm' ? 'ion phantoms' : zone.name === 'Horror' ? 'grave stalkers' : zone.name === 'Psychedelic' ? 'prism wraiths' : zone.name === 'Rave' ? 'glowstick ravers' : zone.name === 'Beach' ? 'angry crabs' : zone.name === 'Foreclosure' ? 'eviction notices' : zone.name === 'Condemned' ? 'bailiffs and vermin' : zone.name === 'Collections' ? 'loan sharks' : zone.name === 'Sunset Strip' ? 'tape heads and synth lords' : zone.name === 'Tracking Error' ? 'CRT heads' : zone.name === 'Arcade Overdrive' ? 'pixel ghosts and cabinets' : 'creatures';
        toast(`${zone.name.toUpperCase()} EVOLVES — ${evolved} moving in`, 2200);
        shockRing(pos, 12, zone.plate);
      }
      function evolveTick(dt) {
        if (state !== 'play' || !activeZ || !BIOME_ENEMIES[activeZ.name]) { evolveT = 16; return; }
        evolveT -= dt;
        if (evolveT > 0) return;
        evolveT = 16 + Math.random() * 12;
        spawnEvolutionPack(activeZ);                                              // steady pressure on the new biome
      }

      Line 3: - 2026-10-26 [BUFFY] GAMEPAD / HANDHELD SUPPORT (Steam Deck, ROG Ally, Legion Go, controllers; user request "joysticks can't control on a handheld"): the game never read the Gamepad API at all, so handheld sticks did nothing. Added `gamepadTick(now)` polled FIRST in the main `renderer.setAnimationLoop` callback (runs every frame, including paused/title so Start works in menus): left stick -> WASD keys map (0.22 deadzone, rescaled to full at rim); right stick -> camYaw/camPitch/fpPitch at the same clamps as the mouse handler (full tilt ~240 deg/s yaw, ~137 deg/s pitch); A(0) jump edge + held-A = keys.Space (glide), B(1) ground pound edge, X(2) = exact KeyE interact semantics (warp/hintNpc/hintProp/vehicle/placeBlock), Y(3) view toggle, RT(7) fire held (attackPress edge + mouseHeld, releases cleanly), LT(6) aim held, RB(5) weapon cycle edge, LB(4) = keys.KeyQ hold (grapple reel; tap = grappleFire() or warpCycle() when on the warp pad, matching Q's precedence), L3(10) = ShiftLeft (sprint / vehicle boost / ride-summon variant), Start(9) pause toggle (ENTER on the title screen via menuKey). Keyboard coexistence: new `kbdKeys` mirror in the keydown/keyup/blur handlers; every gamepad-owned key is recomputed each frame as `kbdKeys[k] || stick/button` so releasing a stick never clobbers a physically-held key and nothing latches. First connection toasts the mapping summary (once per session; reconnect re-toasts). MENUS are keyboard/touch only except title-Start and pause-Start — level select, host/join forms still need touch/keyboard on a handheld. Verification: inline-script `node --check` PASS; `perf/_smoke.cjs` on the patched file produced 0 runtime errors and the NOS (150 chunks / 14873 m road / VCR 10 hubs) + Rent (223 hubs / 6 arenas / Hell 9 hubs) numbers are identical to HEAD's run; default fingerprint wobble (solids +-1 between boot and rebuild, all other counts + seed stable) reproduces on BOTH HEAD and the patched file across repeated runs, so it is the pre-existing build quirk, not this change. NEW reusable test `perf/_gp_test.cjs` (self-snapshots index.html at run start) installs a FAKE gamepad in-page (navigator.getGamepads override), enters play, and verifies move (5.85 m, KeyW true/false), look (yaw -1.571 -> -2.831), jump (Space held + y rise), fire (mouseHeld true->false on release), sprint (ShiftLeft) — ALL PASS, 0 page errors. NOTE for anyone debugging tests here: my first passes failed because (a) the served page never ran its animation loop until the harness stopped replacing `window.__ng = {` outright (must re-emit `window.__ng = {` after the helper object or every later `window.__ng.x =` assignment crashes the module), and (b) headless rAF DOES run on plain pages but the game page only gets a loop when the module survives to `renderer.setAnimationLoop` — use document.title or DOM state to confirm the loop is alive, not window globals. ALSO NOTE: the working tree concurrently gained an UNSAVED-in-HEAD "THE COMMONS" feature (+~330 lines: commonAreaTick/commonsTick/buildCommons/extra hearts) from a parallel agent session while I worked — it is in the working diff but NOT in HEAD commit 9b2c8b4; whoever commits next should either include it deliberately or coordinate with that session before stashing (I stashed/popped this tree mid-A/B and restored it bit-identical). Not deployable from this repo without the usual `npm run deploy:pages`; not played on real hardware — stick feel (yaw rate 4.2 rad/s, pitch 2.4 rad/s, deadzone 0.22) is a first guess and needs a human thumb.

      // Headless mid-band test: three commons locations, three bosses, rewards, maw purge.
      // Boot the real page (single player, net off), teleport to each site, drive the wave pipeline, kill the boss, assert rewards.
      const puppeteer = require('C:/Users/Serge/AppData/Roaming/npm/node_modules/puppeteer');
      const fs = require('fs');
      const SRC = require('path').resolve(__dirname, '..', 'index.html');
      
      (async () => {
        const browser = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: 'C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe', headless: 'new', protocolTimeout: 600000, args: ['--allow-file-access-from-files', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--use-gl=swiftshader', '--no-sandbox', '--mute-audio', '--window-size=1280,800'] });
        const page = await browser.newPage();
        await page.setViewport({ width: 1280, height: 800 });
        await page.setRequestInterception(true);
        page.on('request', req => {
          if (req.url().startsWith('file:') && /index\.html$/.test(req.url())) {
            req.respond({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/html', body: fs.readFileSync(SRC, 'utf8') });
          } else req.continue();
        });
        const errors = [];
        page.on('pageerror', e => errors.push('pageerror: ' + e.message));
        await page.goto('file:///' + SRC.replace(/\\/g, '/'), { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 120000 });
        await page.waitForFunction('window.__ng && window.__ng.mids', { timeout: 180000 });
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000));                       // let the world build + settle
      
        const evl = (fn, ...args) => page.evaluate(fn, ...args);   // args MUST be forwarded (see todo.md gamepad-session note)
        const w = ms => new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, ms));
        const mid = () => evl(() => window.__ng.mids());
      
        const fp0 = await evl(() => window.__ng.commons());
        console.log('commons:', JSON.stringify(fp0));
        const M0 = await mid();
        console.log('mids initial:', JSON.stringify(M0, null, 1));
      
        const runSite = async (site, expectKind) => {
          const gone = await evl(s => window.__ng.midsGo(s), site);
          if (!gone) { console.log(site + ': SITE MISSING (blocked placement) — skip'); return null; }
          await w(700);
          const s1 = await mid();
          const st = s1.sites.find(x => x.site === site);
          console.log(site + ': arrive ->', JSON.stringify(st));
          if (st.missing) return null;
          // drive the pipeline: drop cooldowns (midsStep), kill one unit per pass, let the boss emerge
          let bossSeen = false, guardKills = 0, tries = 0;
          while (tries++ < 24) {
            await evl(s => window.__ng.midsStep(s), site);
            const k = await evl(s => window.__ng.midsKill(s), site);
            await w(1400);

      const puppeteer = require('C:/Users/Serge/AppData/Roaming/npm/node_modules/puppeteer');
      const fs = require('fs');
      const SRC = require('path').resolve(__dirname, '..', 'index.html');
      (async () => {
        const browser = await puppeteer.launch({ executablePath: 'C:/Program Files (x86)/Microsoft/Edge/Application/msedge.exe', headless: 'new', protocolTimeout: 600000, args: ['--allow-file-access-from-files', '--enable-unsafe-swiftshader', '--use-gl=swiftshader', '--no-sandbox', '--mute-audio', '--window-size=1280,800'] });
        const page = await browser.newPage();
        await page.setViewport({ width: 1280, height: 800 });
        await page.setRequestInterception(true);
        page.on('request', req => { if (req.url().startsWith('file:') && /index\.html$/.test(req.url())) req.respond({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/html', body: fs.readFileSync(SRC, 'utf8') }); else req.continue(); });
        page.on('pageerror', e => console.log('pageerror:', e.message));
        await page.goto('file:///' + SRC.replace(/\\/g, '/'), { waitUntil: 'domcontentloaded', timeout: 120000 });
        await page.waitForFunction('window.__ng && window.__ng.mids', { timeout: 180000 });
        await new Promise(r => setTimeout(r, 5000));
        const out = await page.evaluate(() => {
          const mids = window.__ng.mids();
          return {
            commonsExists: !!window.__ng.commons(),
            commonsVal: window.__ng.commons(),
            mids: mids,
            goNest: window.__ng.midsGo('nest'),
            goHouse: window.__ng.midsGo('house'),
            goShroom: window.__ng.midsGo('shroom'),
            posAfter: window.__ng.pos.toArray().map(v => +v.toFixed(1)),
          };
        });
        console.log(JSON.stringify(out, null, 1));
        await browser.close();
      })().catch(e => { console.error('PROBE FAILED:', e.message); process.exit(1); });
